businessModel: Free during public beta; future pricing to be announced
paidNote: Beta is free including flagship models; future pricing not announced
summary: AI-native browser from Meituan's GN06 team, in free public beta since Mar 2026 on Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+. Switch between GPT, Claude and Gemini models, run agents in separate tab groups.
bestFor: People who want to try multiple frontier models for free
Users who like vertical tabs and agent tab groups

pros.title: Multi-model access
pros.detail: International build supports Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 in the beta.

pros.title: Parallel agent tabs
pros.detail: Agent mode runs multi-step tasks in a separate tab group while you keep browsing.

pros.title: Free beta, no invite
pros.detail: No invite code and no API key needed.

pros.title: One-click import
pros.detail: Imports from Chrome, Edge or Safari.

cons.title: Beta software
cons.detail: No stable version and pricing is undecided.

cons.title: Opaque privacy
cons.detail: Vendor says it will not collect user data; not independently verified.

cons.title: Provenance questions
cons.detail: Press noted UI similarity to the open-source ReadFrog; Meituan ties weigh on trust.

jsSpeed: Likely Blink/V8 but engine not confirmed
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
telemetry: Vendor claim only, no policy reviewed
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Vertical tabs and agent tab groups
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: Meituan link, beta pricing unknown, UI-copy allegation
longevity: Public beta from a large-company team
ai: Multi-model chat and agent tab groups
